description: Show brands an operator recently started selling. Use when the user asks 'what new brands did this seller pick up', 'operator new brands', 'what is Amazon Warehouse selling now that it wasn't before', or any question about an operator expanding their catalog.

marketplace_id.description: 1 = Amazon UK, 2 = Amazon US (default), 4 = Amazon CA, 5 = Amazon AU, 6 = Amazon DE, 7 = Amazon JP, 8 = Amazon IT, 9 = Amazon FR, 10 = Amazon ES, 11 = Amazon MX, 12 = Amazon BR

since_days.description: How far back to look for new brands (default 30, max 180).

name: operator_new_brands
